gloss: a party; a faction; a group

definitions.gloss: a party; a faction; a group
definitions.explanation: A group of people united by a common cause, goal, or allegiance. Often used in political contexts to refer to a political party or faction, and more broadly to any organized group or clique.

examples.japanese: {一党|いっとう}{支配|しはい}が{続|つづ}いている。
{彼|かれ}の{一党|いっとう}は{反対派|はんたいは}を{抑|おさ}えた。
{一党|いっとう}{独裁|どくさい}の{体制|たいせい}は{民主主義|みんしゅしゅぎ}とは{相容|あいい}れない。
examples.english: A one-party dictatorship is incompatible with democracy.

notes:
USAGE:
Most commonly encountered in the compound 一党支配 (one-party rule) or 一党独裁 (one-party dictatorship). Can also refer to a group or gang in historical or literary contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {一党|いっとう}{支配|しはい} (one-party rule)
- {一党|いっとう}{独裁|どくさい} (one-party dictatorship)
- {一党|いっとう}{体制|たいせい} (single-party system)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {政党|せいとう}: political party — a neutral term for a political party
- {派閥|はばつ}: faction — a faction within a larger organization
